_comment: Thresholds for the deterministic rubric pre-flight (P04). FAIL-capable metrics: fleschEase (breakdown), tellRateMax, transferMin, memorableCleanMin. fkGrade is ADVISORY (warn-only): review calibration on the real catalog showed the top books read easier than the band (atomic-habits breakdown FK ≈ 4.2 → an FK-min gate would fail 20/20 of its chapters), so the ease band is the enforceable readability ruler and FK is descriptive. House-tic and nominalization are DIAGNOSTIC (warn-only). Rates here are FRACTIONS in [0,1] (tellRate/transferRatio), not score.py's 0..100 percentages. Do NOT tighten a fail band or flip a warn-only metric to fail without a zero-false-positive calibration against book-packages/*.v21.json.
